video_title: The Talking Mickey Mouse Show - The Impossible Journey (1986 Disney Worlds of Wonder Read-Along)
description:
The original 1986 Read-Along storybook & animation cassette that'd come packed in with The Talking Mickey Mouse animated talking toy by Worlds of Wonder. Similar to how Teddy Ruxpin would come packed-in with The Airship book & cassette.
This features the voices of Peter Renaday as Mickey Mouse, Tony Pope as Goofy, Debbie Gates as Minnie Mouse, and Sam Kwasman as Donald Duck (He voiced Donald in this & The Magic Boomerang. However, In The Great Kite Caper & Secret of the Silver Mine, he’s voiced by Tony Anselmo. You can very clearly hear the difference. Sam’s def has more of a Lil’ Quacker sound to his performance. Which of course is ironic as later on, Sam atleast would take over as Lil Quacker for the Tom & Jerry Show. 🙂) 

This book & tape has been out of print for decades and is being uploaded strictly for preservation, educational, & archival purposes as a result. Enjoy!
